title: Integrating AI and Blockchain: Developing AI Standards for Cardano

ms.promise:
A complete and extensive research proposal that clearly defines the requirements for all four pillars, as defined in our project proposal, namely:
・API 
・Certification Procedure
・Benchmarking Procedure
・Consensus Mechanisms
ms.criteria:
The full research proposal is publicly available and contains:
・A section on the motivation and scope of the project.
・Sections on all four pillars (API, Certification Procedure, Benchmarking Procedure, Consensus Mechanisms), in which we define the requirements.
・A critical discussion of the requirements.
・A section summarizing the requirements and outlining the next steps.
ms.report:
We have completed the first milestone, a research proposal, which contains:
・A motivation section.
・Sections on all four pillars defining the requirements.
・A critical discussion of the requirements.
・A section summarizing the requirements and outlining the next steps.

The proposal is available on GitHub: https://github.com/unboundedmarket/AI-Standards
For easier readability, you can also access the proposal here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1X1ImtPnbw3URHp_ZFobESpx-pW4gx2Qo/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise: Theoretical foundation work for the API standard, the certification and the benchmarking procedure.
ms.criteria:
The complete research output summarized in a publicly available PDF and contains:
・A section on related work.
・Individual sections on the API standard, the certification, and the benchmarking procedure. Each section builds on the requirements defined in the research proposal, outlines the proposed approach, and critically discusses it.
・A section summarizing and discussing all approaches.

Furthermore, the research output has been shared with the community via X.
ms.report:
